headword: {資源回収|しげんかいしゅう}

definitions.gloss: resource collection; recyclable collection; recycling pickup
definitions.explanation: The organized collection of recyclable materials such as paper, cans, bottles, and plastic for reuse or recycling. A routine part of waste management in Japanese communities, with designated collection days and sorting rules.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}は{資源回収|しげんかいしゅう}の{日|ひ}だ。
{新聞|しんぶん}や{段|だん}ボールは{資源回収|しげんかいしゅう}に{出|だ}してください。
examples.english: Please put out newspapers and cardboard for recyclable collection.

examples.japanese: この{地区|ちく}では、{月|つき}に{二回|にかい}{資源回収|しげんかいしゅう}が{行|おこな}われ、{住民|じゅうみん}がペットボトルや{空|あ}き{缶|かん}を{分別|ぶんべつ}して{出|だ}している。
examples.english: In this district, recyclable collection takes place twice a month, and residents sort and put out plastic bottles and empty cans.

notes:
Composed of {資源|しげん} (resources) and {回収|かいしゅう} (collection; recovery). In Japan, waste sorting and recycling are taken seriously at the community level. Most neighborhoods have specific days for {資源回収|しげんかいしゅう}, separate from {燃|も}えるごみ (burnable trash) and {燃|も}えないごみ (non-burnable trash).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {資源回収|しげんかいしゅう}の{日|ひ}: recyclable collection day
- {資源回収|しげんかいしゅう}に{出|だ}す: to put out for recyclable collection
- {資源回収|しげんかいしゅう}ボックス: recycling collection box
- {資源回収|しげんかいしゅう}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: recycling collection company

RELATED WORDS:
- {資源|しげん}ごみ: recyclable waste — the items themselves
- {分別|ぶんべつ}: waste sorting
- リサイクル: recycling (general loanword)
- {廃品回収|はいひんかいしゅう}: used goods collection — similar but emphasizes the items are discarded
